title: Book 8 — Urania, Chapter 135
paragraphs: After this, a thing that seems to me a very great marvel is said by the Thebans to have happened. This Mys of Europos, as he journeyed round all the oracles, came also to the sacred precinct of Ptoan Apollo. This temple is called “Ptoon,” belongs to the Thebans, and lies above Lake Copais at the foot of the mountains, close to the town of Acraiphia. When the man called Mys came to this temple with three men chosen from the citizenry, who were sent by public authority to write down whatever the god should utter in his divination, the god's prophet (it is said) at once began to give the oracle in a barbarian tongue; and while the Thebans accompanying him were astonished to hear a foreign language instead of Greek and did not know what to make of the matter, the man of Europos, Mys, snatched the tablet they were carrying and wrote on it what the prophet was saying, saying that the prophet was delivering his answer in the Carian tongue. When he had written it, he went away and returned to Thessaly.
